scripts.verify: cd contracts && forge fmt --check && forge test && cd .. && if [ -f apps/web/package.json ]; then pnpm -C apps/web tsc --noEmit && pnpm -C apps/web lint; fi && if [ -d examples ]; then for d in examples/*/; do [ -f "$d/foundry.toml" ] || continue; (cd "$d" && forge fmt --check && forge test) || exit 1; done; fi
